turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, support speaking, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My package was supposed to arrive five days ago and there is still nothing. This is the second time this happens.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry for the delay. Let me check the tracking. It seems the parcel is stuck at the regional depot.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Stuck where it was three days ago. This is unacceptable, I paid for express shipping.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I cannot release it from here, but I can escalate this to the carrier team.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do that. And if it is not here this week I am cancelling my account and ordering elsewhere.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have raised the escalation and marked it urgent. You will be contacted within one business day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. I will wait, but I am really disappointed.
